note: Teacher reference answers for the narrated exercise; analytic expectations are distinguished from measured training outcomes.

checks.questionEn: Predict gates and errors before increasing frequency
checks.questionZh: 增加频率之前，先预测门控与误差
checks.answerEn: The phase advance grows from6 to8 radians over the unit time interval, while the normalised exact energy remains one. The residual terms contain omega, but parameter-gradient norms also depend on the current network, so there is no universal4/3 gradient ratio. Larger early residuals may close later causal gates more strongly; measure gates, completed updates, full-state errors and energy drift instead of assuming faster or better training.
checks.answerZh: 单位时间内相位推进从六弧度增至八弧度，而归一化精确能量仍为一。残差项含 omega，但参数梯度范数也依赖当前网络，因此不存在普遍的三分之四梯度比。较大的早期残差可能更强地关闭后期门控；应测量门控、完成更新数、全状态误差和能量漂移，不能假定训练必然更快或更好。
